events.title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 6 released
events.summary: Samsung began selling the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 6 — Galaxy AI features on Samsung's flagship foldable line.
events.about: Foldables forced Android developers to handle resizable and multi-window layouts on flexible displays. Galaxy ai features on samsung's flagship foldable line.

narrative.whyImportant: Foldable form factors require adaptive UI patterns beyond fixed phone screens.
